purpose: Stories for a test drive from Noida Extension (Casa Greens 1) to the Tijara Jain temple. Covers both likely roads: via Faridabad and the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway, and via Gurugram, Sohna and Bhiwadi.
qualityNote: Each story is built from the linked source. Facts were checked by web search on 2026-11-23, not by a human editor. Hindi text was written alongside the English and has not been reviewed by a native editor.
coordinateNote: Looked up on OpenStreetMap: Okhla Barrage, Surajkund, Old Faridabad, Bhiwadi, Tijara town, Firozpur Jhirka, Gurugram. Estimates that should be checked on a map: Nahar Singh Mahal (Ballabhgarh), Sohna hot spring, Tijara fort-palace, Tijara Jain temple, and the three area stories (Delhi-Mumbai Expressway, Aravalli hills near Sohna, Mewat).
wordingNotes: Surajkund's builder (Surajpal) is tradition, and is worded that way.
Firozpur Jhirka's founding is 'said to be', following Britannica.
The Gurugram and Dronacharya link is a belief, and is worded that way.
The dream in the Tijara idol story is what devotees say, and is worded that way.
'Longest expressway in India' is the government's description.

Sources differ on the exact date in August 2023 for the new district; the story says only 'August 2023'. A later report says the district may be renamed Bhartrihari Nagar; not included because it was not confirmed.
The Tijara palace history comes from the hotel company's own page.
